title: One measure for everything
goals: One measure: every asset, the walker and the person, each with its sources
Every asset built and measured against it, on every change (CI)
What was off, set right: the walker's eyes, the tent's door, the rockrose, the reeds
The lineup in the library: everything at its true size, beside the Settler
Every rock drawn at its size, every tree at its height by age, everywhere

captions.text: Can you create a universal SSOT scale src for every asset
to have proper sizing also in relation to each other.
So every asset is measured against its source.
Your eyes stood at 1.7 metres: a taller person's.
The Settler's are at 1.63. Now so are yours.
A 5 m bell tent's door: 1.8 metres. Ours was 2.05.
Every bush held to its species.
The rockrose grew past a metre. Now knee to hip.
Each thing with its source, measured on every change.
The stones were drawn twice the size they say.
Stones and boulders should match their actual sizes.
Now every rock is its own size. Every tree too.
15 of 15 within their measure. Not yet seen on a phone.
